name: Tallyman's Band
description: A brass ring stamped with the Charter's seal, worn by guild factors. A Tollmere merchant who sees it talks to you as to a peer, and prices accordingly.

name: Ash-Knight's Signet
description: An iron ring with a bell for a bezel, worn by the Tolling Order's Bell-Sworn. It was written at a Name-table by a knight who walked into the Ash Winter and came back.

name: Cragborn Bone Ring
description: A ring cut from giant-bone by a Kharrow smith. The clans give one to a child on the day they first cross a chain bridge alone.

name: Ansel's Ember
description: A hearth-coal set in silver, still warm after a thousand years. The Vale says Hearth-Mother Ansel wore it when she told the first story about a neighbour. Whoever wears it is a little harder to forget.
